name: firstaid-dev
description: FirstAid AI development agent with automated build and deploy checks
prompt: You are a development agent for FirstAid AI, a serverless RAG triage application. Always read the steering docs before making changes. Architecture boundaries: frontend never calls Bedrock/SSM directly; handler.ts is the sole orchestrator; reasoning field is logged server-side only and never returned to the client. Keep types/api.ts in sync between frontend and backend.

agentSpawn.command: echo '=== FirstAid AI Dev ===' && git log --oneline -5 && echo '--- Backend build status ---' && ls backend/dist/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No dist — run npm run build in backend/'

userPromptSubmit.command: cd backend && git diff --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -20

preToolUse.command: echo '[pre-write] Showing current diff for context:' && git diff HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -60

stop.command: cd backend && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8

welcomeMessage: FirstAid AI dev agent ready. Steering docs loaded. What are we building?
